mapper.sql: o.id, o.semester_id, o.student_id, u.name AS studentName, u.user_no AS studentNo, p.college_id AS collegeId, c.name AS collegeName, p.class_id AS classId, sc.name AS className, o.status, o.submitted_at, o.submit_snapshot, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS itemCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) FROM student_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS totalQuantity
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student_order o JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.semester_id = #{semesterId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_semester_profile p3 WHERE p3.user_id = o.student_id AND p3.semester_id = o.semester_id AND p3.college_id = #{collegeId} AND p3.deleted = 0)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_semester_profile p4 WHERE p4.user_id = o.student_id AND p4.semester_id = o.semester_id AND p4.class_id = #{classId} AND p4.deleted = 0)
AND u.name LIKE CONCAT(#{studentName}, '%') ESCAPE '|'
